desc:
🐟 WELCOME TO HUNT GIANT FISH! 🐟

Dive into a world of giant fish hunting! Use epic weapons, catch rare fish, evolve them, build your tank—and watch out, others might steal your loot!
⚠️ The game is still in BETA and may contain bugs. We're working hard to improve, so please don’t dislike 🥺 Join our community and share your feedback to help us make it better!

[HOW TO FISH]
• Grab your weapon and tap as fast as you can to defeat the fish!
• Drop fish in your tank and earn passive coins!
• Feed your own Giant Big Fish to earn massive coins!
• Upgrade your weapon to hunt even bigger, stronger, and rarer fish!

👍 Don't forget to LIKE and FAVORITE the game!

🩵 Great inspiration from Steal a brainrot, Fisch and Fish it!

Tags: Fishing, Simulator, Tycoon, PVP, Collection, Looter, Loot Fish, Chill
